title: Boilerplate screenshots
asked: Backfilled from CLAUDE.md Status (built before builds reported themselves).

result.summary: boilerplate@1 takes optional `screenshots: [{file, screen?, caption?}]`, files in `framework/boilerplates/<id>/screenshots/` (PNG/JPEG/WebP, plain names, ≤ 5 MB, no SVG). Console `GET /api/boilerplates/<id>/screenshots/<file>` serves them (admin/console token; refuses links, traversal, other types).
